summary_en: This study tests VS-7375, an oral KRAS G12D (ON/OFF) inhibitor, alone and in combination with other drugs, in adults with advanced solid tumors that have a KRAS G12D mutation, including pancreatic, lung, and colorectal cancer. VS-7375 is taken by mouth, and combination arms also use cetuximab, carboplatin with pemetrexed and pembrolizumab, gemcitabine with nab-paclitaxel, pembrolizumab, or defactinib; how long or how often these are given is not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability at escalating doses to find a recommended phase 2 dose in the early phase, and treatment efficacy in the phase 2 groups.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa VS-7375, un inhibidor oral de KRAS G12D (ON/OFF), solo y en combinación con otros medicamentos, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que tienen una mutación de KRAS G12D, incluidos el cáncer de páncreas, de pulmón y colorrectal. VS-7375 se toma por vía oral, y los grupos de combinación también usan cetuximab, carboplatino con pemetrexed y pembrolizumab, gemcitabina con nab-paclitaxel, pembrolizumab o defactinib; no se indica cuánto tiempo ni con qué frecuencia se administran. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerabilidad con dosis crecientes para determinar una dosis recomendada para la fase 2 en la etapa inicial, y la eficacia del tratamiento en los grupos de fase 2.
who_for: Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic solid tumor with a KRAS G12D mutation.
Measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1.
Recovered from side effects of previous therapies to grade 1 or less, or to baseline.
not_for: Prior treatment with direct RAS inhibitors.
Symptomatic, untreated, or actively growing brain metastases.
Chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or radiation (except palliative radiation) within 4 weeks or 5 half-lives before Cycle 1 Day 1.
